problems_found.line: CORE_PAGES_ZH.method.title (page H1, was "收入放缓，成本上升：您的团队在等一个决定")
problems_found.problem: H1 was 18 characters across three clauses and carried 您, violating both the 14-character/two-beat zh headline cap and "no 您/你 in any headline" (spec §13, zh-register.md §5 rule 5/27). The English H1 is the owner's own verbatim example and is exempt from the 9-word cap, but no equivalent exemption exists for the Chinese rendering — it must still meet the general zh limit.
problems_found.fix_applied: Rewrote to "收入放缓、成本走高，团队待决" — 14 characters, two beats, no pronoun, preserves both pressures (revenue, costs) and the team-waiting fact.

problems_found.line: CORE_PAGES_ZH.method.sections (two entries, section keys "…在您自己的机构内")
problems_found.problem: These section keys render as <h2> via ChineseCorePage and contained 您, another headline-pronoun violation.
problems_found.fix_applied: Changed "在您自己的机构内" to "在自己机构内" in both between-session section keys; body copy (which correctly keeps 您) was untouched.

problems_found.problem: Servant-leadership gloss used half-width parentheses with a leading ASCII space — "仆人式领导 (servant leadership)" — inconsistent with the full-width-bracket typography rule (zh-register.md §5 rule 23) and with the faculty block's own correct rendering.
problems_found.fix_applied: Changed to full-width brackets, no space: "仆人式领导（servant leadership）".

problems_found.problem: Extra task: the writer left the old F.A.S.T.-method metadata ("F.A.S.T. 管理决策方法" / decision-method description) untouched after rewriting the page around the new "what changes across the six months" narrative spine — metadata no longer matched the page content or the updated English metadata.
problems_found.fix_applied: Added a FACTS import and rewrote metadata to match the new English framing: title "{FACTS.durationMonths} 个月内，会有什么改变"; description names what happens in/between sessions, the faculty-reviewed written plan, and what stays with the participant afterwards, tokenized via FACTS.durationMonths.

owner_questions: Confirm the compressed ZH H1 "收入放缓、成本走高，团队待决" is an acceptable register-driven shortening of the owner's four-clause English example H1 for this page, since no locked ZH example exists for /how-it-works in the spec.
notes: Servant leadership is still named exactly once on this page (F.A.S.T. section), per spec §6. npm run typecheck and node scripts/content-clarity-audit.mjs both pass with zero warnings in this unit's files.
